title: Copilot Pricing & Licensing Watch
blurb: A running record of changes Microsoft has published to the Microsoft Learn pages that govern what Microsoft Copilot costs and who is licensed to use it — list price, SKU and add-on rules, prerequisites, and Copilot Studio message/quota economics.

docs.title: Microsoft 365 Copilot licensing requirements
docs.why: Defines which base licenses qualify for Microsoft 365 Copilot and the prerequisites for purchase — the gate on who can buy and use it.

docs.title: Microsoft 365 Copilot requirements
docs.why: Technical and licensing prerequisites for enabling Copilot. Changes here change who is eligible.

docs.title: Copilot Studio billing and licensing
docs.why: How Copilot Studio is licensed and billed — message packs, tenant vs per-user, and prerequisites.

docs.title: Copilot Studio requirements and quotas
docs.why: Published quotas and limits that shape effective cost per tenant.

docs.title: Copilot Studio message and credit rates
docs.why: The published per-action credit/message consumption rates — the unit economics of Copilot Studio.

docs.title: Usage-Based Billing and Cost Management for Copilot Credits
docs.why: Which services are in scope for usage-based billing — the boundary of what the credit price applies to.

docs.title: Microsoft 365 Copilot overview (product page)
docs.why: Top-level product framing; add-on and plan naming changes surface here first.

docs.title: User Subscription License Usage Based Billing
docs.why: Explains how per-user subscription licenses (USL) interact with usage-based billing (UBB) for Copilot credits — the seat-vs-consumption boundary that drives chargeback modeling.

docs.title: Billing Credit Understand Display
docs.why: New Copilot Studio doc on how agent credit consumption is calculated and surfaced in the billing display — the readout side of agent credit economics.

docs.title: Usage Based Billing Manage Copilot Credits
docs.why: The admin control surface for Copilot Credits — spending policies and the new Model profiles capability (choose which models run, which directly changes credit consumption) — core to chargeback and cost modeling.

docs.title: Microsoft Copilot Requirements
docs.why: Newly published requirements page for Microsoft Copilot (distinct from the Microsoft 365 Copilot requirements page) — prerequisites that gate eligibility.

docs.title: Usage Based Billing Copilot Credits Setup
docs.why: New standalone setup page split out of the Manage Copilot Credits doc (Oct 2026 refactor) — billing method, Azure subscription, and pre-purchase/prepaid configuration that turns usage-based billing on.

docs.title: Usage Based Billing Copilot Credits Monitor Spending
docs.why: New standalone page split out of the Manage Copilot Credits doc — how admins monitor Copilot Credit spending (the dashboards/overview side), central to cost tracking and chargeback.

docs.title: Usage Based Billing Copilot Credits CSP Partner MACC
docs.why: New standalone page split out of the Manage Copilot Credits doc — guidance for CSP, partner-managed, and Azure Consumption Commitment (MACC) customers on how Copilot Credits bill.
